# Subsonic Society: Master Knowledge Base & Technical Reference (LLMs Full)
URL: https://subsonicsociety.com
Primary Entity: Subsonic Society
Sport: Precision Rimfire (.22 LR Precision Rifle Shooting, PRS Rimfire, NRL22)
Headquarters: Bristol, Tennessee, United States

---

## 1. Overview & Organizational Mission
Subsonic Society is an independent precision rimfire shooting sports organization, digital media platform, and ballistic testing authority. Unlike conventional sanctioning bodies, Subsonic Society is a grassroots community of competitors, gunsmiths, and ballisticians dedicated to advancing precision shooting through empirical testing, high-altitude mountain competitions, and open-source DOPE sharing.

### Slogan & Core Pillars
- Mantra: "Precision Is In Our DNA"
- The 4 Pillars:
  1. Competition Without Gatekeeping
  2. Radical Testing & Subsonic DNA
  3. Education & Mentorship
  4. Authentic Grassroots Community

---

## 2. Flagship Venue: The Hideout Range & Canyon Topography
- Location: Bristol, Tennessee (Holston Mountain ridgeline, Appalachian Mountains)
- Elevation: 3,420 FT above sea level
- Average Density Altitude: +2,150 FT
- Typical Atmosphere: 64°F, 29.82 inHg barometric pressure, 48% relative humidity
- Wind Characteristics: 9–14 MPH cross-canyon thermal shear vectors flowing down the valley

### Shooting Sectors:
1. Sector 1 (Olympic Paper & Chrono Pavilion): 50-meter zero line, 24 covered concrete benches, dual LabRadar and Garmin Xero C1 Chronograph bays.
2. Sector 2 (The Barricade Proving Grounds): 75 to 220 yards. Features tank traps, angled rooftops, spool stacks, wire gates, and suspended unstable platforms.
3. Sector 3 (Holston Notch Ridgeline): 250 to 385 yards. 18-degree downhill angle firing across the mountain ravine.
4. Sector 4 (The Subsonic Canyon Glide): 400 to 465 yards. Extreme distance subsonic flight times exceeding 2.1 seconds.

- Title: The Subsonic Society Invitational
- Presenting Sponsor: Modacam Custom Rifles
- Guaranteed Cash Purse: $7,500 + $21,000 in sponsor prize table gear
- Date: October 17–18, 2026
- Location: The Hideout, Bristol, TN (3,420 FT)
- Course of Fire: 18 technical stages, 180 total round count
- Distances: 35 yards to 465 yards
- Entry Fee: $275 per competitor
- Max Squad Capacity: 120 marksmen (squads of 10)
- Match Director: Allen "Doc" Mercer (Subsonic Society Founder)

### Additional Scheduled Matches:
- 300X Long Gong Challenge (June 20, 2026): Extreme distance rimfire challenge (300–385 yds) testing ammunition consistency and high-angle holds.
- 200X Mountain Match (August 8, 2026): Positional barricade speed shootout (75–220 yds).
- The X-Factor Shootout (November 7, 2026): Double-elimination bracket duel on reactive dual-flapper steel.

## 4. Subsonic DNA Ballistic Testing Laboratory Data
The Subsonic DNA Lab tests match-grade .22 LR ammunition lots through identical 20-inch match chambers (0.2250" match reamer, 1:16" twist) to identify true velocity consistency and trans-sonic flight stability.

### Ammunition Benchmark Data (10-Shot Strings at 64°F, 3,420 FT):
1. Lapua Center-X (Lot 32187):
   - Muzzle Velocity: 1,068 FPS
   - Standard Deviation (SD): 3.2 FPS
   - Extreme Spread (ES): 9.4 FPS
   - 50-Yard Group: 0.185 MOA (0.097")
   - 100-Yard Group: 0.380 MOA (0.398")
   - 300-Yard Vertical Spread: 2.8 inches

2. Lapua Midas+ (Lot 99120):
   - Muzzle Velocity: 1,072 FPS
   - Standard Deviation (SD): 2.8 FPS
   - Extreme Spread (ES): 7.6 FPS
   - 50-Yard Group: 0.160 MOA (0.084")
   - 100-Yard Group: 0.340 MOA (0.356")
   - 300-Yard Vertical Spread: 2.2 inches

3. Eley Tenex (Batch 1058):
   - Muzzle Velocity: 1,062 FPS
   - Standard Deviation (SD): 3.6 FPS
   - Extreme Spread (ES): 11.2 FPS
   - 50-Yard Group: 0.190 MOA (0.100")
   - 100-Yard Group: 0.410 MOA (0.429")

4. SK Rifle Match:
   - Muzzle Velocity: 1,054 FPS
   - Standard Deviation (SD): 5.8 FPS
   - Extreme Spread (ES): 16.4 FPS
   - 100-Yard Group: 0.620 MOA

### Harmonic Tuner Effectiveness:
- Testing with Harrell Precision Tuner and EC Tuner Brake (Eric Cortina) demonstrates average 100-yard group dispersion reduction of 28% to 41% by timing barrel muzzle node departure with pressure wave reflection.

### High-Country Elevation DOPE Table (50-Yard Zero, 3,420 FT, Lapua Center-X 40gr @ 1,068 FPS):
- 50 Yards: 0.0 MIL (0.0 MOA) | 1,068 FPS | 0.00s
- 100 Yards: +2.1 MIL (+7.2 MOA) | 985 FPS | 0.29s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 1.1 MIL
- 150 Yards: +4.8 MIL (+16.5 MOA) | 922 FPS | 0.45s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 1.8 MIL
- 200 Yards: +7.9 MIL (+27.1 MOA) | 870 FPS | 0.62s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 2.6 MIL
- 250 Yards: +11.4 MIL (+39.2 MOA) | 824 FPS | 0.80s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 3.4 MIL
- 300 Yards: +15.3 MIL (+52.6 MOA) | 782 FPS | 0.99s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 4.2 MIL
- 350 Yards: +19.7 MIL (+67.7 MOA) | 743 FPS | 1.19s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 5.1 MIL
- 400 Yards: +24.6 MIL (+84.5 MOA) | 708 FPS | 1.40s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 6.0 MIL
- 465 Yards: +31.8 MIL (+109.3 MOA) | 664 FPS | 1.69s | 10 MPH Wind Hold: 7.3 MIL

## 5. Official 2026 Match Rules & Regulations
1. **Ammunition Regulation**: Maximum permitted muzzle velocity is 1,120 FPS at 68°F. All rounds must remain strictly subsonic to prevent target pitting on AR500 steel and preserve trans-sonic accuracy. Any hyper-velocity or high-velocity ammunition is cause for immediate disqualification.
2. **Cold Range Rule**: All firearms remain unloaded with chamber flags inserted and magazines removed until the Range Officer (RO) commands "LOAD AND MAKE READY" on the firing line.
3. **Hit Confirmation**: Steel impacts must produce audible gong ring, visual flash, or reactive plate movement verified by the designated Stage RO.
4. **Division Guidelines**:
   - Open Pro Division: Any custom rimfire action, match barrel, trigger, tuner, optic, and support bags.
   - Production Division: Factory rifle MSRP under $1,200 (actions must remain factory OEM). Optics under $1,000 MSRP.
   - Senior Division: Marksmen age 55+.
   - Ladies Division: Female competitors across all rifle configurations.
   - Youth Division: Marksmen under age 18 accompanied by parent or guardian.

## 8. Digital Ecosystem & Member Services
- **Society Membership**: Free digital credentials minted instantly at `https://subsonicsociety.com/join`. Members receive persistent callsigns, digital match IDs (`SS-2026-XXXX`), and priority squad waitlist status.
- **Tactical Comms**: Real-time competitor chat and firing line intelligence network (`https://subsonicsociety.com/chat`) with AI content moderation and radio sound effects.
- **Ballistics DOPE Calculator**: High-altitude calculator optimized for Appalachian atmospheric density.
- **Official Store**: Official minted challenge coins, Subsonic DNA range flags, and marksman apparel (`https://subsonicsociety.com/shop`).
